title: mdRNAcat: A Molecular Dynamics RNA Catalog of REST2 Conformational Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2610.35204v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning molecular models of RNA requires simulation data that capture conformational variability and provide consistent physical training signals. Here, we introduce mdRNAcat, a curated dataset of all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of 48 RNA systems selected to promote sequence diversity. Each system is simulated using replica-exchange with solute scaling (REST2), with 32 Hamiltonian states and production lengths of 200-300 ns per state. The dataset provides atomic coordinates, instantaneous forces, and forces reevaluated under the unscaled reference Hamiltonian, together with structural annotations and replica-exchange metadata. Coordinates and forces are available at 1 ps intervals for the reference state and 100 ps intervals across all states in a standardized HDF5 format. translated_title: mdRNAcat：基于REST2构象集合的分子动力学RNA目录
translated_abstract: 构建 RNA 的分子模型需要能够捕捉构象变化并提供一致物理训练信号的模拟数据。在此，我们介绍了 mdRNAcat，这是一个经过精心整理的数据集，包含 48 个 RNA 体系的全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟，这些体系的选取旨在提升序列多样性。每个体系均采用溶质缩放副本交换方法（REST2）进行模拟，包含 32 个哈密顿量状态，每个状态的生产模拟时长为 200-300 纳秒。该数据集提供原子坐标、瞬时力，以及在未缩放参考哈密顿量下重新评估的力，并附带结构注释和副本交换元数据。坐标和力数据以标准化的 HDF5 格式提供，参考状态的数据间隔为 1 皮秒，所有状态的数据间隔为 100 皮秒。我们通过分析构象采样、交换行为、碱基配对以及糖环折叠分布，记录了模拟集合的性质。
tldr: 该论文推出了 mdRNAcat，一个包含 48 个 RNA 体系的 REST2 副本交换全原子分子动力学模拟整理数据集，提供了坐标、力、结构注释及元数据，为学习 RNA 分子模型提供了高质量的训练数据。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces mdRNAcat, a curated dataset of all-atom REST2 replica-exchange molecular dynamics simulations of 48 RNA systems, providing coordinates, forces, structural annotations, and metadata to support learning molecular models of RNA.
